ownership.investor.holdings.Definition

This class describe parameters to retrieve investor name, count and holdings data for any requested investor.

Available as lseg.data.content.ownership.investor.holdings.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    universe: StrStrings,
    limit: int | None = None,
    use_field_names_in_headers: bool = False,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe StrStrings Yes The Universe parameter allows the user to define the companies for which the content is returned.
limit int | None No None The limit parameter is used for paging. It allows users to select the number of records to be returned. Default page size is 100 or 20 (depending on the operation).
use_field_names_in_headers bool No False Return field name as column headers for data instead of title
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
